title: 第3章 词条提示第4章 李青山
slug: 全族助我加点我举族飞升天界
content_zh:
虽然如此，但李北玄并没有将心中所想给表露出来，甚至他苍老的脸上带着些许威严。
对于李天行的做法，他可是非常赞同的，果真不愧是他的好大儿啊！
甚至在心中还要给他点个赞！
对于现在的他来说，每一个族人都是非常的重要，宝贵！
特别是族中的这些修士，损失任何一个，对他来说都是莫大的损失！
毕竟，这些修士可都关乎着他能否续住他这条老命的啊！
想到这里，李北玄对便宜儿子李天行的做法越发满意。
于是他笑着看向李天行，微微颔首，“天行啊，你做的很不错，若是没有足够的把握，便不要让家族陷入危险之中。”
只要能够保全家族，不过是忍受些气罢了！
等到他解决了寿元危机，而后再隐忍到突破紫府境界。
到了那个时候，区区一个周家还不是任由他随意拿捏！
至于现在，只要自己还出现在其他四大家族的视野当中。
凭借原主昔日的余威，周家在没有探清他的虚实之前，也并不会贸然对他们李家出手！
所以，他们李家现在的处境，相对来说还是安全的。
因此，李北玄脸上不着痕迹地继续对李天行说道，“行了，既然我已经出关，尔等便无需理会周家之事，待时机合适，我自会找他们算账！”
“是，阿爹，天行知道了！”听到老爹所言，李天行神色激动地回应道。
悬在他心中的大石头，在这一刻也终于是落了下来，让他整个人都感到无比的轻松踏实。
其他长老听闻老祖所言，纷纷面露喜色，脸上再也没有了一丝担忧之色。
因为他们知道，只要他们李家有老祖坐镇，谅他周家也不敢再对他们李家出手了。
见在场众人都安静下来。

李北玄可没有忘记他这次过来寻找李天行的目的。
他要举全族之力，去培养族中即将要突破的族人，他要保证这个月之内必须有族人突破境界。
哪怕只是突破一个小境界都行！
“天行，族中可有天资出众之人？”李北玄看向李天行出言询问道。
听到父亲的询问，虽然不知道他有何用意，但还是出声回道，“爹，族中确实有一个族人的资质尚可！
他便是我们李家六代弟子李青山，今年年仅十六岁便已突破到后天境界。
也是我们李家年轻一辈最有希望突破先天境界之人！
爹，你看，是否需要将青山传唤过来？”
李北玄听到李天行的回答，心中顿时一喜。
十六岁便突破到了后天境界，足以说明这名族人天资出众了。
“族中有如此天才，若是对其进行重点培养，说不定会有意想不到的收获！”他在心中暗自思索起来。
可就在李北玄要开口之时，却是突然愣住了！
因为一个信息面板突然出现在了他的眼前。
信息面板上面显示着。
词条提示：
族人：李天行
修为：先天初期
资质：绿色
评价：该资质有45%的几率突破先天中期，当前已是先天初期，不建议培养！
当李北玄看清信息面板上的内容时，他的心中却是不淡定了。

“这～我竟然还能看到族人的资质详情！我这岂不是真的要起飞了！”
content_en:
Despite this, Li Beixuan did not express what was in his heart, and even his old face showed a bit of majesty.
He very much agreed with Li Tianxing's approach. He was indeed his great eldest son!
I even want to give him a thumbs up in my heart!
For him now, every clan member is very important and precious!
Especially for these monks in the clan, the loss of any one of them would be a huge loss to him!
After all, these monks are all related to whether he can continue his old life!
Thinking of this, Li Beixuan became more and more satisfied with the behavior of his son Li Tianxing.
So he looked at Li Tianxing with a smile and nodded slightly, "Tianxing, you have done a good job. If you are not sure enough, don't put the family in danger."
As long as the family can be preserved, it's just a matter of enduring some anger!
Wait until he resolves the longevity crisis, and then endures until he breaks through the Zifu realm.
At that time, the Zhou family was not just at his mercy!
As for now, as long as he still appears in the sight of the other four major families.
Relying on the original owner's former power, the Zhou family would not rashly attack the Li family before they found out his real identity!
Therefore, the current situation of their Li family is relatively safe.
Therefore, Li Beixuan continued to say to Li Tianxing without any trace on his face, "Okay, since I have been released, you don't need to pay attention to the Zhou family's affairs. When the time is right, I will settle the score with them!"
"Yes, Dad, Tianxing knows!" Li Tianxing responded excitedly after hearing what his father said.
The big stone hanging in his heart finally fell down at this moment, making him feel extremely relaxed and at ease.
When the other elders heard what the ancestor said, they all looked happy, and there was no trace of worry on their faces anymore.
Because they know that as long as their Li family has their ancestors in charge, the Zhou family will not dare to take action against their Li family again.
Everyone present was quiet.
Li Beixuan has not forgotten his purpose of coming here to find Li Tianxing.
He wants to use the strength of the entire clan to train the clan members who are about to break through. He wants to ensure that there must be clan members who break through within this month.
Even if it’s just a small breakthrough!
"Tianxing, is there anyone with outstanding talent in the clan?" Li Beixuan looked at Li Tianxing and asked.
After hearing his father's question, although he didn't know what his intention was, he still replied loudly, "Dad, there is indeed a member of the clan who has acceptable qualifications!
He is Li Qingshan, the sixth generation disciple of our Li family. He has already broken through to the acquired realm at the age of sixteen this year.
He is also the most promising person among the younger generation of our Li family to break through the innate realm!
Dad, look, do you need to summon Qingshan? "
Li Beixuan felt happy when he heard Li Tianxing's answer.
Breaking through to the acquired realm at the age of sixteen is enough to show that this tribesman has outstanding talent.
"There is such a genius in the clan. If we focus on cultivating him, we may have unexpected gains!" He thought secretly in his heart.
But just when Li Beixuan was about to speak, he suddenly froze!
Because an information panel suddenly appeared in front of him.
displayed on the information panel.
Entry tips:
Clan: Li Tianxing
Cultivation: Early stage of Xiantian
Qualification: Green
Evaluation: This qualification has a 45% chance of breaking through the middle stage of innateness. It is currently in the early stage of innateness and is not recommended to be cultivated!
When Li Beixuan saw the contents on the information panel clearly, he felt uneasy.
"This~ I can actually see the qualification details of my clan members! Am I really about to take off!"
